title: Logger helper API (get_logger + log_event + round context binding)
prompt:
Add helpers: get_logger(run_id) returns a bound logger; log_event(**fields) validates via LogEvent and emits; context binding so run_id/round propagate. Keep files <150 lines.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: TDD: wrote packages/log/tests/test_helpers.py FIRST (9 cases: get_logger binds run_id into emitted JSONL; log_event writes one validated JSON line with run_id/round/agent/event_type/payload; an invalid event_type raises ValidationError and writes NOTHING (sink file never created); a missing required field (round) raises before emit; bind_round(7) propagates to a later log_event; an explicit round kwarg overrides the bound round; clear_context drops the bound round so a round-less log_event raises; get_logger is idempotent (no duplicate JSONL lines); optional tokens/latency_ms pass through). Watched red (ImportError: cannot import bind_round/clear_context/get_logger/log_event), then implemented. New module packages/log/src/agent_debate/log/_api.py (~40 code lines, <=150) ties together 1.1 configure() + 1.2 LogEvent: get_logger(run_id, *, runs_dir=DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR) thin idempotent wrapper over configure() returning a run_id-bound logger with the per-run JSONL sink wired; log_event(*, run_id, agent, event_type, round=None, payload=None, tokens=None, latency_ms=None, runs_dir=DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR) builds+VALIDATES a LogEvent FIRST (so unknown event_type / missing required field raises pydantic.ValidationError before any emit), then emits via the configured logger so it serialises as one runs/<run_id>.jsonl line, and returns the validated event. Context binding via structlog.contextvars: bind_context(**fields), bind_round(round_) (binds the 'round' contextvar key), clear_context() -> clear_contextvars; round resolution prefers an explicit kwarg, else the bound contextvar round, else None (=> validation rejects as missing required field). No-hardcoding: runs_dir defaults to DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR (single source of truth in _setup.py); the 'round' contextvar key is a module constant _ROUND_KEY; reuses the existing sink (no duplication). Re-exported get_logger, log_event, bind_context, bind_round, clear_context from agent_debate.log __init__ (__all__ updated). Scope kept tight (no redaction/cost accounting -> later tasks). No external API calls -> API gatekeeper (Epic 13) N/A. Gates green locally: ruff check (auto-fixed import ordering: structlog grouped with first-party after isort), ruff format --check, mypy strict (33 files, fixed initial round:int|None typing + an em-dash that broke a type:ignore by building a dict[str,Any] kwargs so pydantic is the sole validator), pytest --cov (125 passed, 100% total, _api.py 100%), check_line_limit.py, secret_scan.py.
